landing.title: SafeVoice
landing.subtitle: A safe, private way to tell someone what happened.
consent.title: Before you start
consent.point1: You can tell us what happened by speaking.
consent.point2: Nothing is saved until you agree.
consent.point3: We will not ask for your name.
consent.point4: You can stop at any time.
consent.point5: A computer program turns your voice into text and helps judge how urgent your report is. A trained case worker always reads or listens to your report.
consent.point6: Your report is kept private and is deleted after 24 months.
